fluff.overview: The Blessed Order maintained conventional infantry formations equipped with preserved Star League-era weapons and personal armor, fielding platoons that were better armed than most Successor State infantry throughout the late Succession Wars. Mechanized tracked platoons ride armored personnel carriers that provide all-terrain mobility and meaningful protection against small arms and shrapnel. The tracked transport allows these platoons to keep pace with armor formations across broken ground where wheeled vehicles would bog down. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these troops field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
